en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestone square with a few children and pedestrians scattered across it. On the left stands a three‑storey historicist building with a steep tiled roof and ornate windows, likely a municipal or school building. In the center background is a larger, more industrial‑looking multi‑storey block with chimneys emitting smoke. On the right is a long, low row of older houses with shops at street level; signs above two entrances are visible. The architecture suggests a Central European town square in the early 20th century.
